title: Florida's 15th Congressional District election, 2026
description: The election for Florida's 15th Congressional District will be held on November 3, 2026, with a primary on August 18, 2026. Incumbent Republican Rep. Laurel Lee is seeking re-election in a district that covers parts of Hillsborough, Pasco, and Polk counties in the Tampa Bay area. The district was redrawn under a new congressional map passed in April 2026 that is expected to favor Republicans, and Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Solid R.' Democratic primary candidates include Jose Engell, Christopher Irizarry, and Robert People, who are vying to challenge Lee in the general election.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for this race as of mid-2026. The Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Solid R,' indicating a strong Republican lean.

candidates.name: Laurel Lee
candidates.summary: Laurel Lee is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Florida's 15th Congressional District, first elected in 2022 and re-elected in 2024. She previously served as Florida Secretary of State (2019–2022) and as a circuit court judge in Hillsborough County (2013–2019). She is running for re-election in the 2026 cycle and faces no announced Republican primary challenger.

candidates.name: Jose Engell
candidates.summary: Jose Engell (Democratic Party) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent Florida's 15th Congressional District in the 2026 Democratic primary. He filed his candidacy in May 2025 and is described as a Generation Z candidate from Tampa. As of early 2026, Engell had reported no financial activity to the FEC.

candidates.name: Christopher Irizarry
candidates.summary: Christopher Irizarry is a Democratic candidate running for U.S. House in Florida's 15th Congressional District. He is a U.S. Army veteran and retired CIA officer from Pasco County. Irizarry initially filed to run in the 12th district but shifted to the 15th district after redistricting in April 2026.

summary_sources.title: Redistricting shuffle: Chris Irizarry shifts congressional bid from CD 12 to CD 15 - Florida Politics

candidates.name: Robert People
candidates.summary: Robert People is a Democratic candidate running for U.S. House in Florida's 15th Congressional District. He is a retired U.S. Army veteran who declared his candidacy in February 2025. As of early 2026, People had raised under $9,000 in campaign funds according to FEC filings.

summary_sources.title: Darren McAuley flies into race to challenge Laurel Lee in CD 15 - Florida Politics

forecast.rationale: No public opinion polls are available for this race, which tempers confidence. However, the non-polling signals are consistently very strong: incumbent Republican Rep. Laurel Lee is running unopposed in her primary; the district was redrawn in April 2026 under a map expected to favor Republicans; Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Solid R'; and the Democratic primary field features three candidates (Engell, Irizarry, People) who, based on available summaries, have minimal fundraising (People under $9k, Engell no reported financial activity) and no clearly top-tier challenger. The combination of incumbency, a favorable map, a strong national rating, and a weak opposition field supports a safe Republican advantage, but the complete absence of polling data introduces enough uncertainty to warrant medium rather than high confidence.
